    // How it works

    Four steps, no gatekeeping

    1. 01

      Apply

      One form, three links to your work. We reply within a week.

    2. 02

      Build

      We help you structure the first live session or the first module.

    3. 03

      Launch

      Your page, your pricing, your dates. We promote it to the audience.

    4. 04

      Get paid

      Monthly payout on the 5th, with a statement that adds up.
